```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: perf-benchmark-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: pr

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      # PR branch: install, lint, test, build
      - name: Install dependencies (PR)
        run: |
          cd pr
          npm ci
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Lint (PR)
        run: |
          cd pr
          npm run lint
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Test (PR)
        run: |
          cd pr
          npm run test
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Build (PR)
        run: |
          cd pr
          npm run build || true
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Benchmark PR
        id: benchmark_pr
        run: |
          cd pr
          # Warmup runs
          npm pack > /dev/null
          npm pack > /dev/null
          # Measured runs
          times=()
          for i in {1..5}; do
            start=$(date +%s.%N)
            npm pack > /dev/null
            end=$(date +%s.%N)
            elapsed=$(echo "$end - $start" | bc)
            times+=($elapsed)
          done
          # Median
          sorted=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
          median=${sorted[2]}
          echo "PR_TIME=$median" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          CI: true

      # Main branch: install, build
      - name: Install dependencies (main)
        run: |
          cd main
          npm ci
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Build (main)
        run: |
          cd main
          npm run build || true
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Benchmark main
        id: benchmark_main
        run: |
          cd main
          # Warmup runs
          npm pack > /dev/null
          npm pack > /dev/null
          # Measured runs
          times=()
          for i in {1..5}; do
            start=$(date +%s.%N)
            npm pack > /dev/null
            end=$(date +%s.%N)
            elapsed=$(echo "$end - $start" | bc)
            times+=($elapsed)
          done
          # Median
          sorted=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
          median=${sorted[2]}
          echo "MAIN_TIME=$median" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Compute diff
        id: compute_diff
        run: |
          pr=$PR_TIME
          main=$MAIN_TIME
          diff=$(echo "$pr - $main" | bc)
          diff_pct=$(echo "scale=2; $diff / $main * 100" | bc)
          echo "DIFF=$diff" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DIFF_PCT=$diff_pct" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Format comment
        id: format_comment
        run: |
          sign="+"
          if (( $(echo "$DIFF < 0" | bc -l) )); then sign="-"; fi
          pr_time=$(printf "%.2f" $PR_TIME)
          main_time=$(printf "%.2f" $MAIN_TIME)
          diff_time=$(printf "%.2f" $DIFF)
          diff_pct=$(printf "%.1f" $DIFF_PCT)
          cat <<EOF > comment.md
          | | Time |
          |---|---:|
          | PR branch | ${pr_time}s |
          | main branch | ${main_time}s |
          | **Diff** | **${sign}${diff_time}s (${sign}${diff_pct}%)** |
          EOF
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Post comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message-path: comment.md
          comment-tag: perf-benchmark
          mode: update
          create-if-not-exists: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
